theorem_title: Soundness of an arithmetic quarter-gap certificate
natural_language_statement:
Let $n,d,a,b,C,s\in\mathbb N$ satisfy $n>0$, $a<b$, $b(n+d)=an+C$, and $4C\le sb$. Then

$$
4d<s.
$$

This is an arithmetic certificate independent of the Collatz map and does not assert that the hypotheses hold on any orbit.
